scientific_integrity: An elementary proof covering all positive integer parameters is supplied; finite exhaustive checks corroborate but are not used to infer the infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Exact formulas are restricted to binary periodic words consisting of two nonempty constant-symbol runs per period.
Counts distinct contiguous antisquare factors, not their occurrences in arbitrary finite prefixes.
An unindexed prior equivalent formula remains a bibliographic possibility.
Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Complete antisquare spectra of two-block periodic binary words
